title: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral - English Studies - Vowel Sounds
exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words contains the same vowel sound as the word 'bat' `/æ/`?
questions.explain: The word 'bat' contains the short monophthong `/æ/`. Among the options, 'cat' also has the `/æ/` sound. 'Car' has `/a:/`, 'cot' has `/ɒ/`, and 'cut' has `/ʌ/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that has the vowel sound `/ʊ/` as in 'book'.
questions.explain: The word 'book' is pronounced with the short vowel `/ʊ/`. 'Pull' also contains the `/ʊ/` sound, whereas 'fool', 'pool', and 'tool' contain the long vowel `/u:/` (moon).
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of these words contains the long vowel sound `/i:/` as in 'beat'?
questions.explain: The word 'seat' contains the long vowel `/i:/`. The words 'sit', 'bit', and 'fit' all contain the short vowel `/i/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Find the odd word out based on the vowel sound.
questions.explain: The words 'hot', 'cot', and 'pot' all share the `/ɒ/` (short 'o') sound. 'But' contains the `/ʌ/` sound (as in cup).
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words contains the vowel sound `/ɜ:/`?
questions.explain: The word 'bird' has the long vowel sound `/ɜ:/`. 'Bed' has `/e/`, 'bud' has `/ʌ/`, and 'bad' has `/æ/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that contains the vowel sound `/ʌ/` as in 'cup'.
questions.explain: The word 'hut' uses the `/ʌ/` sound (short 'u'), exactly like 'cup'. 'Cop' uses `/ɒ/`, 'cap' uses `/æ/`, and 'coop' uses `/u:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words contains the long vowel sound `/a:/` as in the word 'car'?
questions.explain: The word 'part' shares the long monophthong `/a:/` with the word 'car'. 'Cat' has `/æ/`, 'cot' has `/ɒ/`, and 'pet' has `/e/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Identify the word that uses the vowel sound `/ɔ:/` like in the word 'law'.
questions.explain: The word 'saw' contains the long vowel `/ɔ:/`. 'Cow' and 'now' contain the diphthong `/au/`, while 'so' contains `/əʊ/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which of the following words begins with the schwa sound `/ə/` as in 'about'?
questions.explain: The word 'away' begins with the unstressed schwa sound `/ə/`. 'Apple' begins with `/æ/`, while 'aunt' and 'arch' begin with `/a:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Find the word that contains the short vowel sound `/e/` as found in 'bed'.
questions.explain: Despite its spelling, the word 'head' is pronounced with the short vowel `/e/`. 'Hard' is `/a:/`, 'hide' is `/ai/`, and 'heed' is `/i:/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q: Which word has the short vowel sound `/i/` as in 'sit'?
questions.explain: The word 'hit' features the short vowel `/i/`. 'Heat' uses the long `/i:/`, and 'sight'/'site' use the diphthong `/ai/`.
questions.exam: BECE English Studies: Spoken English & Oral
questions.subject: English Studies
